span.p:
Memory stays allocated
But nobody can access it
Program uses MORE memory
Slows down the system

span.p:
IR Analogy:
Renting hotel rooms for delegates
who have already left the country.
The rooms stay booked forever.
Eventually: NO ROOMS AVAILABLE.
